fieldValues.title: Enablers rank before the work they enable
fieldValues.decision_question: In what order do we rank objectives and work?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Work that enables other work is ranked before the work it enables.
fieldValues.rationale: Ordering is a rule; the ranked list it produces is a plan and is not recorded here.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a ranked list shows an enabler below the work that depends on it, or when ranking an enabler first delays visible work for a whole cycle.
